dr_all.def: the nearest untaken daily/weekly/monthly level or opening-gap edge (PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, PMH/PML, NWOG/NDOG) is on the trade's target side

dr_pd.def: daily draw: the previous day's high (long) is untaken and nearer than an untaken PDL (or PDL is taken)

dr_pw.def: weekly draw: the previous week's high/low on the target side is the untaken / nearer one

dr_pm.def: monthly draw: the previous month's high/low on the target side is the untaken / nearer one

dr_gap.def: the nearest unfilled NWOG/NDOG edge is on the target side

dr_more.def: more untaken HTF levels within 1.5 VIX moves on the target side than behind the trade

dr_reach.def: an untaken HTF level sits between the entry and the VIX-band target (a draw on the way)

dr_swept_htf.def: the sweep took a daily, weekly or monthly level (PDL/PWL/PML for a long)

dr_pd_rev.def: the sweep took PDL (long) while PDH is still untaken: the classic daily reversal

pl_eq1h.def: the nearest untaken 1H equal-highs/lows pool is on the target side

pl_eq4h.def: the nearest untaken 4H equal-highs/lows pool is on the target side

pl_sw1h.def: the nearest unswept 1H swing is on the target side

pl_sw4h.def: the nearest unswept 4H swing is on the target side

pl_take1h.def: the sweep took an unswept 1H swing low (long) / high (short)

pl_take4h.def: the sweep took an unswept 4H swing low (long) / high (short)

pl_take_eq.def: the sweep took 1H or 4H equal lows (long) / highs (short)

rg_pd.def: entry in the discount (long) / premium (short) half of the previous day's range

rg_pw.def: entry in the discount / premium half of the previous week's range

rg_20d.def: entry in the discount / premium half of the last 20 days' range

rg_wk.def: entry in the discount / premium half of this week's range so far

rg_4h.def: entry in the discount / premium half of the 4H dealing range (last confirmed 4H swing high-low)

po3_d.def: the sweep went beyond the 18:00 daily open (the manipulation leg of the day's candle)

po3_d_buy.def: the entry is still on the cheap side of the 18:00 open (below it for a long)

po3_4h.def: the sweep went beyond the 4H candle's open within the first 2 hours of that 4H candle

po3_wk.def: the sweep went beyond the weekly open

po3_00.def: the sweep went beyond the midnight open

c1h_counter.def: the last closed 1H candle closed against the trade

c4h_counter.def: the last closed 4H candle closed against the trade

cd_counter.def: the previous day's candle closed against the trade

bi_pdc.def: the previous day closed in the half of its range on the trade's side (upper half for a long)

bi_pdbos.def: the previous day closed beyond the day before's high (long) / low (short)

bi_pdts.def: the previous day swept the day before's low (long) and closed back above it (daily turtle soup)

bi_pwc.def: the previous week closed in the half of its range on the trade's side

ms_1h.def: the last 1H break of structure (close beyond a fractal swing) was in the trade's direction

ms_4h.def: the last 4H break of structure was in the trade's direction

ms_d.def: the last daily break of structure was in the trade's direction

fv_way1h.def: an unfilled opposing 1H FVG sits between the entry and the target

fv_way4h.def: an unfilled opposing 4H FVG sits between the entry and the target

fv_sweep1h.def: the sweep ran into an unfilled supportive 1H FVG

fv_sweep4h.def: the sweep ran into an unfilled supportive 4H FVG

tw_how.def: the sweep extreme is inside Tue 03:00 - Wed 11:30 (the high/low-of-week window)

tw_wkext.def: the sweep made a new low (long) / high (short) of the week

tw_wkext_mw.def: the sweep made a new weekly low/high on Monday-Wednesday (weekly low/high formation)

cx_with.def: WITH the HTF draw: at least 2 of (nearest untaken HTF level on the target side, last 4H BOS with the trade, previous day closed on the trade's side)

cx_full.def: all 3 of the HTF-draw items agree with the trade

cx_against.def: AGAINST the HTF draw: none of the 3 items agrees

lt_trap6.def: fresh trap: the inducement swing was made <= 6 bars (30 min) before the sweep

lt_trap_close.def: close trap: the inducement swing sits < 0.39 ATR above the swept level

lt_major.def: the sweep took a daily/weekly/monthly level or an opening-gap edge

lt_box.def: the sweep took a session box (Asia / London / NY / premarket)

lt_bu_only.def: the sweep took only build-up (equal 5m) liquidity

lt_rr4.def: the VIX-band target is 4R or more away

lt_room.def: room to run: the first opposing level is >= 1.5R away

lt_lv30.def: 30 or fewer levels already taken today

lt_news_clear.def: no high-impact release in the next 60 min

lt_es_swept.def: ES swept its own low/high too (no SMT divergence)

lt_day_ext.def: the sweep is the day's extreme so far

lt_opp_lon.def: the day's opposite extreme was made in London

lt_vec.def: a vector (climax volume) candle at the sweep

lt_first.def: the first accepted setup of the day

lt_prev_win.def: the previous LIT trade was a winner

lt_cisd_long.def: the CISD run into the extreme is 5+ bars
